import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return

    n = data[0]
    arr = data[1:1 + n]

    seen = set()
    left = 0
    best = 0

    for right, value in enumerate(arr):
        while value in seen:
            seen.remove(arr[left])
            left += 1

        best = max(best, right - left + 1)
